summary_en: Kakaku.com board update: rival tender offer from Bain Capital & LINE Yahoo at 3,520 yen/share (3,640 yen if KDDI non-acceptance agreement secured) supersedes initial Kamgras 1 tender at 3,450 yen/share. Tender period extended to 2026-08-17 (67 business days total). Board to negotiate with both offerors to determine which transaction better serves company value and shareholder interests. Special committee recommendation and board support stance unchanged.
title_en: Notice of Partial Change: Opinion Statement Supporting and Recommendation for Tender Offer by Kamgras 1 Inc. for Kakaku.com Inc. Common Shares (Revised)
translation_en_brief: Kakaku.com (ticker 2371, TSE Prime) issued an update on 2026-08-03 regarding its take-private tender offer. The company's special committee and board previously supported an initial public tender by Kamgras 1 Inc. at 3,450 yen per share for full delisting (non-公開化). On 2026-07-29, the board received a rival competing proposal from Bain Capital (through BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. and affiliated investment funds) and LINE Yahoo Corporation to increase the tender price to 3,520 yen per share, or 3,640 yen per share if a non-acceptance agreement with KDDI is concluded. These two competing tenders cannot proceed simultaneously. The board has engaged with the original offeror (Kamgras 1) under their take-private contract to discuss price adjustment, and will negotiate in good faith with both parties to determine which transaction better serves the company's enterprise value and the common interests of shareholders. The special committee's recommendation and the board's support for the original Kamgras 1 tender remain unchanged pending further evaluation. The tender period has been extended to 2026-08-17, totaling 67 business days, after the original offeror filed an amended tender notice on 2026-07-31.
